title: Failed donor transfers
subtitle: The donor transfers that failed or are still retrying, and the cancelled requests whose transfer posted anyway. Each line says what it asks of you.

filters.hint: The filters narrow the loaded queue. A line with no attempt yet is never hidden by the dates.
